title: षोडशोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 16 · Indra is found and restored

summary.en: Brihaspati praises Agni, who agrees to enter the waters and finds Indra in the lotus stalk. Brihaspati praises Indra, who regains his strength, and the gods assign the guardians of the quarters their realms, Yama over the ancestors and Varuna over the waters.
summary.kn: ಬೃಹಸ್ಪತಿ ಅಗ್ನಿಯನ್ನು ಸ್ತುತಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ, ಅಗ್ನಿ ನೀರನ್ನು ಪ್ರವೇಶಿಸಲು ಒಪ್ಪಿ ಕಮಲದ ದಂಟಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಇಂದ್ರನನ್ನು ಕಾಣುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಬೃಹಸ್ಪತಿ ಇಂದ್ರನನ್ನು ಸ್ತುತಿಸಿದಾಗ ಅವನು ಬಲ ಮರಳಿಪಡೆಯುತ್ತಾನೆ; ದೇವತೆಗಳು ದಿಕ್ಪಾಲಕರಿಗೆ ರಾಜ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಹಂಚುತ್ತಾರೆ, ಪಿತೃಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಯಮ, ಜಲದ ಮೇಲೆ ವರುಣ.
summary.hi: बृहस्पति अग्नि की स्तुति करते हैं, जो जल में प्रवेश करने को मानकर कमल-नाल में इन्द्र को पाते हैं। बृहस्पति इन्द्र की स्तुति करते हैं, जिससे वे अपना बल पुनः पाते हैं, और देवता दिक्पालों को उनके राज्य सौंपते हैं, पितरों पर यम और जल पर वरुण।
summary.te: బృహస్పతి అగ్నిని స్తుతిస్తాడు, అగ్ని నీటిలో ప్రవేశించడానికి అంగీకరించి తామర కాడలో ఇంద్రుని కనుగొంటాడు. బృహస్పతి ఇంద్రుని స్తుతించగా అతడు బలాన్ని తిరిగి పొందుతాడు; దేవతలు దిక్పాలకులకు రాజ్యాలు పంచుతారు, పితరులపై యముడు, జలాలపై వరుణుడు.
summary.ta: ப்ருஹஸ்பதி அக்னியைத் துதிக்க, அக்னி நீருள் புக இசைந்து தாமரைத் தண்டில் இந்திரனைக் காண்கிறான். ப்ருஹஸ்பதி இந்திரனைத் துதிக்க அவன் வலிமை மீள்கிறது; தேவர்கள் திக்பாலகர்களுக்கு அவரவர் ஆட்சியை அளிக்கிறார்கள், பித்ருக்கள் மீது யமன், நீர் மீது வருணன்.
summary.ml: ബൃഹസ്പതി അഗ്നിയെ സ്തുതിക്കുന്നു; വെള്ളത്തിൽ പ്രവേശിക്കാൻ സമ്മതിച്ച അഗ്നി താമരത്തണ്ടിൽ ഇന്ദ്രനെ കണ്ടെത്തുന്നു. ബൃഹസ്പതി ഇന്ദ്രനെ സ്തുതിക്കുന്നു; ഇന്ദ്രൻ ശക്തി വീണ്ടെടുക്കുന്നു. ദിക്പാലകർക്ക് അവരുടെ മേഖലകൾ ദേവന്മാർ നിശ്ചയിക്കുന്നു; പിതൃക്കൾക്ക് മേൽ യമനും ജലത്തിന് മേൽ വരുണനും ചുമതലയേൽക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 5.16; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Jan 23 2024

verses.text: बृहस्पतिरुवाच

meaning.en: Brihaspati said:

verses.text:
त्वमग्ने सर्वदेवानां मुखं त्वमसि हव्यवाट् ।
त्वमन्तः सर्वभूतानां गूढश्चरसि साक्षिवत् ॥

meaning.en: Agni, you are the mouth of all the gods and the bearer of oblations; hidden within all beings, you move as a witness.

verses.text:
त्वामाहुरेकं कवयस्त्वामाहुस्त्रिविधं पुनः ।
त्वया त्यक्तं जगच्चेदं सद्यो नश्येद्धुताशन ॥

meaning.en: Poets call you one, and again threefold; if you left this world it would perish at once, eater of oblations.

verses.text:
कृत्वा तुभ्यं नमो विप्राः स्वकर्मविजितां गतिम् ।
गच्छन्ति सह पत्नीभिः सुतैरपि च शाश्वतीम् ॥

meaning.en: Bowing to you, Brahmins go with their wives and sons to the eternal state won by their own deeds.

verses.text:
त्वमेवाग्ने हव्यवाहस्त्वमेव परमं हविः ।
यजन्ति सत्रैस्त्वामेव यज्ञैश्च परमाध्वरे ॥

meaning.en: You alone, Agni, are the oblation-bearer and the highest oblation; they worship you alone with rites and sacrifices in the great sacrifice.

verses.text:
सृष्ट्वा लोकांस्त्रीनिमान्हव्यवाह
प्राप्ते काले पचसि पुनः समिद्धः ।
सर्वस्यास्य भुवनस्य प्रसूति-
स्त्वमेवाग्ने भवसि पुनः प्रतिष्ठा ॥

meaning.en: Having created these three worlds, bearer of oblations, in due time you cook them again, kindled; you are the source of all this world, Agni, and again its support.

verses.text:
त्वामग्ने जलदानाहुर्विद्युतश्च त्वमेव हि ।
दहन्ति सर्वभूतानि त्वत्तो निष्क्रम्य हायनाः ॥

meaning.en: Agni, they call you the cloud-giver, and you alone are lightning; all beings burn when your flames leave you.

verses.text:
त्वय्यापो निहिताः सर्वास्त्वयि सर्वमिदं जगत् ।
न तेऽस्त्यविदितं किंचित्त्रिषु लोकेषु पावक ॥

meaning.en: All the waters rest in you, and this whole world is in you; nothing in the three worlds is unknown to you, Purifier.

verses.text:
स्वयोनिं भजते सर्वो विशस्वापोऽविशङ्कितः ।
अहं त्वां वर्धयिष्यामि ब्राह्मैर्मन्त्रैः सनातनैः ॥

meaning.en: Everyone goes to his own source; enter the waters without fear. I shall make you grow with eternal Vedic mantras.

verses.text: शल्य उवाच

meaning.en: Shalya said:

verses.text:
एवं स्तुतो हव्यवाहो भगवान्कविरुत्तमः ।
बृहस्पतिमथोवाच प्रीतिमान्वाक्यमुत्तमम् ।
दर्शयिष्यामि ते शक्रं सत्यमेतद्ब्रवीमि ते ॥

meaning.en: Thus praised, the god Agni, bearer of oblations and best of sages, was pleased and said to Brihaspati these excellent words: I shall show you Shakra; I tell you truly.

verses.text:
प्रविश्यापस्ततो वह्निः ससमुद्राः सपल्वलाः ।
आजगाम सरस्तच्च गूढो यत्र शतक्रतुः ॥

meaning.en: Then Agni entered the waters, with their seas and pools, and came to that lake where Shatakratu was hidden.

verses.text:
अथ तत्रापि पद्मानि विचिन्वन्भरतर्षभ ।
अन्वपश्यत्स देवेन्द्रं बिसमध्यगतं स्थितम् ॥

meaning.en: There, searching among the lotuses, O best of Bharatas, he saw the king of gods standing inside a lotus stalk.

verses.text:
आगत्य च ततस्तूर्णं तमाचष्ट बृहस्पतेः ।
अणुमात्रेण वपुषा पद्मतन्त्वाश्रितं प्रभुम् ॥

meaning.en: He came back quickly and told Brihaspati that the lord, in a tiny body, had taken shelter in the lotus fiber.

verses.text:
गत्वा देवर्षिगन्धर्वैः सहितोऽथ बृहस्पतिः ।
पुराणैः कर्मभिर्देवं तुष्टाव बलसूदनम् ॥

meaning.en: Then Brihaspati went with the divine sages and Gandharvas and praised the god, destroyer of Bala, with tales of his ancient deeds.

verses.text:
महासुरो हतः शक्र नमुचिर्दारुणस्त्वया ।
शम्बरश्च बलश्चैव तथोभौ घोरविक्रमौ ॥

meaning.en: Shakra, you killed the dreadful great demon Namuchi, and Shambara and Bala, both of terrible valor.

verses.text:
शतक्रतो विवर्धस्व सर्वाञ्शत्रून्निषूदय ।
उत्तिष्ठ वज्रिन्संपश्य देवर्षींश्च समागतान् ॥

meaning.en: Shatakratu, grow; destroy all your enemies. Rise, wielder of the thunderbolt, and see the divine sages gathered here.

verses.text:
महेन्द्र दानवान्हत्वा लोकास्त्रातास्त्वया विभो ।
अपां फेनं समासाद्य विष्णुतेजोपबृंहितम् ।
त्वया वृत्रो हतः पूर्वं देवराज जगत्पते ॥

meaning.en: Mahendra, by slaying the Danavas you saved the worlds, lord. Taking the foam of waters, strengthened by Vishnu's power, you killed Vritra, king of gods, lord of the world.

verses.text:
त्वं सर्वभूतेषु वरेण्य ईड्य-
स्त्वया समं विद्यते नेह भूतम् ।
त्वया धार्यन्ते सर्वभूतानि शक्र
त्वं देवानां महिमानं चकर्थ ॥

meaning.en: You are the best and the most praised among all beings; there is no being equal to you here; by you all beings are upheld, Shakra; you made the greatness of the gods.

verses.text:
पाहि देवान्सलोकांश्च महेन्द्र बलमाप्नुहि ।
एवं संस्तूयमानश्च सोऽवर्धत शनैः शनैः ॥

meaning.en: Protect the gods and the worlds, Mahendra, and regain your strength. So praised, he grew little by little.

verses.text:
स्वं चैव वपुरास्थाय बभूव स बलान्वितः ।
अब्रवीच्च गुरुं देवो बृहस्पतिमुपस्थितम् ॥

meaning.en: Taking his own form, he became full of strength, and the god said to his teacher Brihaspati, who stood near:

verses.text:
किं कार्यमवशिष्टं वो हतस्त्वाष्ट्रो महासुरः ।
वृत्रश्च सुमहाकायो ग्रस्तुं लोकानियेष यः ॥

meaning.en: What task remains for you? The great demon, Tvashtri's son, has been killed, and Vritra of huge body who wished to swallow the worlds.

verses.text: बृहस्पतिरुवाच

meaning.en: Brihaspati said:

verses.text:
मानुषो नहुषो राजा देवर्षिगणतेजसा ।
देवराज्यमनुप्राप्तः सर्वान्नो बाधते भृशम् ॥

meaning.en: Nahusha, a mere man, king, through the radiance of the groups of gods and sages, has gained the kingdom of the gods, and troubles us all greatly.

verses.text: इन्द्र उवाच

meaning.en: Indra said:

verses.text:
कथं नु नहुषो राज्यं देवानां प्राप दुर्लभम् ।
तपसा केन वा युक्तः किंवीर्यो वा बृहस्पते ॥

meaning.en: How did Nahusha gain the hard-to-get kingship of the gods? With what austerity, or what power, Brihaspati?

verses.text: बृहस्पतिरुवाच

meaning.en: Brihaspati said:

verses.text:
देवा भीताः शक्रमकामयन्त
त्वया त्यक्तं महदैन्द्रं पदं तत् ।
तदा देवाः पितरोऽथर्षयश्च
गन्धर्वसंघाश्च समेत्य सर्वे ॥

meaning.en: The gods, afraid, wanted you, Shakra; when you had left that great Indra's position,

verses.text:
गत्वाब्रुवन्नहुषं शक्र तत्र
त्वं नो राजा भव भुवनस्य गोप्ता ।
तानब्रवीन्नहुषो नास्मि शक्त
आप्यायध्वं तपसा तेजसा च ॥

meaning.en: the gods, ancestors, sages and groups of Gandharvas all gathered and went to Nahusha, saying: Be our king and protector of the world. Nahusha answered: I am not able; strengthen me with your austerity and energy.

verses.text:
एवमुक्तैर्वर्धितश्चापि देवै
राजाभवन्नहुषो घोरवीर्यः ।
त्रैलोक्ये च प्राप्य राज्यं तपस्विनः
कृत्वा वाहान्याति लोकान्दुरात्मा ॥

meaning.en: So addressed, and strengthened by the gods, Nahusha of terrible power became king; and having won rule over the three worlds, that evil one makes the ascetics carry him through the worlds.

verses.text:
तेजोहरं दृष्टिविषं सुघोरं
मा त्वं पश्येर्नहुषं वै कदाचित् ।
देवाश्च सर्वे नहुषं भयार्ता
न पश्यन्तो गूढरूपाश्चरन्ति ॥

meaning.en: His sight is poison, taking away energy, very terrible; never look at Nahusha. All the gods, afraid of Nahusha, move about in hidden forms, not seeing him.

verses.text: शल्य उवाच

meaning.en: Shalya said:

verses.text:
एवं वदत्यङ्गिरसां वरिष्ठे
बृहस्पतौ लोकपालः कुबेरः ।
वैवस्वतश्चैव यमः पुराणो
देवश्च सोमो वरुणश्चाजगाम ॥

meaning.en: While Brihaspati, best of the Angirases, was speaking thus, the world-guardian Kubera came, and Vaivasvata Yama, the ancient, and the god Soma and Varuna.

verses.text:
ते वै समागम्य महेन्द्रमूचु-
र्दिष्ट्या त्वाष्ट्रो निहतश्चैव वृत्रः ।
दिष्ट्या च त्वां कुशलिनमक्षतं च
पश्यामो वै निहतारिं च शक्र ॥

meaning.en: They met Mahendra and said: By good fortune Tvashtri's son and Vritra have been killed; by good fortune we see you well and unhurt, with your enemy slain, Shakra.

verses.text:
स तान्यथावत्प्रतिभाष्य शक्रः
संचोदयन्नहुषस्यान्तरेण ।
राजा देवानां नहुषो घोररूप-
स्तत्र साह्यं दीयतां मे भवद्भिः ॥

meaning.en: Shakra greeted them properly and urged them, with Nahusha in mind: Nahusha, king of the gods, of terrible form; you should give me help against him.

verses.text:
ते चाब्रुवन्नहुषो घोररूपो
दृष्टीविषस्तस्य बिभीम देव ।
त्वं चेद्राजन्नहुषं पराजये-
स्तद्वै वयं भागमर्हाम शक्र ॥

meaning.en: They said: Nahusha is terrible, his sight is poison, and we fear him, god; if you defeat him, king, we deserve a share, Shakra.

verses.text:
इन्द्रोऽब्रवीद्भवतु भवानपां पति-
र्यमः कुबेरश्च महाभिषेकम् ।
संप्राप्नुवन्त्वद्य सहैव तेन
रिपुं जयामो नहुषं घोरदृष्टिम् ॥

meaning.en: Indra said: Let you, lord of the waters, Yama and Kubera obtain the great anointing, and together with him we shall conquer the enemy Nahusha of terrible gaze.

verses.text:
ततः शक्रं ज्वलनोऽप्याह भागं
प्रयच्छ मह्यं तव साह्यं करिष्ये ।
तमाह शक्रो भविताग्ने तवापि
ऐन्द्राग्नो वै भाग एको महाक्रतौ ॥

meaning.en: Then Agni said to Shakra: Give me a share, and I will help you. Shakra said to him: You too, Agni, shall have one share together with Indra in the great sacrifice.

verses.text:
एवं संचिन्त्य भगवान्महेन्द्रः पाकशासनः ।
कुबेरं सर्वयक्षाणां धनानां च प्रभुं तथा ॥

meaning.en: Thus considering, the blessed Mahendra, Paka's chastiser, honored Kubera, lord of all the Yakshas and of wealth,

verses.text:
वैवस्वतं पितॄणां च वरुणं चाप्यपां तथा ।
आधिपत्यं ददौ शक्रः सत्कृत्य वरदस्तदा ॥

meaning.en: and Vaivasvata Yama, lord of the ancestors, and Varuna, lord of waters; the boon-giving Shakra gave them lordship, honoring them.
